speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned suffering from a chronic cough and recurrent bronchitis; to begin our assessment, how long has this cough been present, and have you noticed any specific triggers or changes in your environment?

speaker: Patient
text: 51-year-old woman. The patient has been experiencing an aggressive cough producing copious amounts of thick, foamy, yellow-green sputum for about 11 years, with exacerbations similar to the current presentation today. Reports that the cough is worse in the morning and has had multiple evaluations in the past due to recurrent bouts of bronchitis requiring antibiotics treatment. The patient is a non-smoker.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchiectasis.

Thank you for those details; the 11-year duration of copious, thick, foamy yellow-green sputum in a non-smoker is highly suggestive of this condition. To confirm the diagnosis and assess the extent of lung damage, I will request a High-Resolution CT scan of the chest. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_CT_High_Resolution.
